Compare the complete local relative maps
Native Thom: F⁺ = (η + i s(t)) / √(1 + η²).
Near its zero: η + i t; real Jacobian det = −1.
Circle clutch: 1 − χ(η) + χ(η)eⁱᵗ.
With χ′(0) = 1/2 and δ = t − π:
linearization = −η − iδ/2; det = −1/2.
Constant phase −1 and positive scales
give η + iδ; translation moves π to 0.

The actual native exchange reverses grading once
U = (σₓ + σᵧ) / √2; UσₓU* = σᵧ, UσᵧU* = σₓ, UΓU* = −Γ.
bF ⊠ bC = −bsum; ℓF ⊠ ℓC = −ℓsum for odd p, physical order F then circle.
s ⊠ κ = −(a ⊠ u)(bF ⊠ bC) = (a ⊠ u) bsum.
(a ⊠ u) ℓsum = (aℓF) ⊠ (uℓC) = −aℓF; uℓC = −1.
Full circle index: Ind(s ⊠ κ) = −Ind(s). Cancel −1 to obtain Ind(s) = aℓF.
Transverse suspension: the same signs on both sides
δSE σ₀ = −σ₁ εE: disk/sphere and analytical boundaries each contribute this minus.
